name: Juke Diva Stutter
desc: FUSES footwork's vocal-chop stutter machine (vox.footwork.chop_stutter) with disco-soul diva material (vox.disco.soul_chop): dirt-samples yeah shouts get triplet-repeated, pitch-flipped and thrown around the 160 grid.

code.full: s("<[yeah:2 ~ yeah:5 ~] [~ yeah:11 ~ ~] [yeah:2 yeah:2 ~ yeah:7] [~ ~ yeah:5 ~]>").speed(sine.range(${pitch}*.85,${pitch}*1.15).slow(6)).ply("<1 1 ${stutter} 1>").shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(2)).hpf(220).lpf(6000).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(9)).room(.2).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: s("<[yeah:2 yeah:2 yeah:5 ~] [yeah:11 ~ yeah:11 yeah:7] [yeah:2 ~ yeah:5 yeah:5] [yeah:7 yeah:7 ~ yeah:11]>").speed(sine.range(${pitch}*.75,${pitch}*1.3).slow(4)).ply("<${stutter} 1 ${stutter} 2>").shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72,${gain}).fast(4)).hpf(250).lpf(7000).pan(sine.range(.32,.68).slow(5)).room(.15).every(4, x=>x.rev()).orbit(8).play()
